name: Turtle Party
source:
Turtle Party is a short visual novel in which you're invited to attend...a Turtle Party! The town of Cape Luna hosts this party every year, as a celebration of rejuvenation and new beginnings, and to watch over the newly hatched baby sea turtles as they make their way out to sea.

Meet five different locals of Cape Luna, and decide who you'd like to create a new beginning with!

[From [url=https://brockie.itch.io/turtle-party] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
海龟派对是一部短篇视觉小说，邀请你参加……海龟派对！卢纳角镇每年都会举办这个聚会，庆祝复兴和新的开始，并在刚孵化的小海龟出海时对其进行监护。

认识五位不同的卢纳角当地人，并决定你想与谁一起创造新的开始！

[来自[url=https://brockie.itch.io/turtle-party] itch.io[/url]]
